note: Nigeria's large card issuers were tried: Stanbic IBTC, Access Bank and Zenith Bank (Access and Zenith are among the largest banks by assets; Stanbic IBTC is the best-known naira credit card issuer). Stanbic IBTC Bank's page for its Visa Platinum Naira credit card (read 30 October 2026): interest of 3% a month, a new card fee of N1,075, a management fee of 1% of the limit at issuance, renewal and each limit increase (written at issue and at a raise; renewal isn't written, as the page doesn't say how often it falls), and up to 55 days interest free. Its other credit cards' pages couldn't be found from the bank's listing, which loads them by script; its 2023 pricing guide, the latest the bank serves, gives 2.5% a month and is older than the card page, so isn't used. Access Bank's rates guide gives its personal credit cards (naira Classic; dollar Black, Platinum, American Express Gold and Platinum) joining, maintenance, late, cash advance and conversion fees and an interest rate of '2.5% on outstanding balance' without the period it's charged by, so they aren't written; Access's American Express page, which a search showed stating a monthly rate, answered 504 three times. Zenith Bank Nigeria publishes no card tariff that could be found.
